description.narrative: Mit dem Projekt zielt die Projektorganisation auf einen kombinierten Ansatz für individuelle und gesellschaftliche Rehabilitierung ab, um gegenseitiges Verständnis und ein friedliches Zusammenleben im Irak zu fördern. With this project, the project organization aims at a combined approach for individual and social rehabilitation in order to promote mutual understanding and peaceful coexistence in Iraq. On the one hand, the approach continues to include qualified therapeutic work in the field of mental and psychosocial health and trauma processing at individual and small group level. On the other hand, it aims to bridge social divides and promote peace-building initiatives by initiating joint events and debates between members of different groups and developing and implementing community-building activities.
